result:
I fixed it in `archiveIssuesForProject` in `src/server/repositories/issue-repository.ts`: archiving a project now only archives that project's issues that are still live. The existing tests for the project service, repositories and server all pass, but no test covers this exact case yet.

The function used to stamp every issue in the project with a new archive date, even ones already archived. That's how the 3 older issues got this week's date and why the audit log said 12 instead of 9.

The count this function returns feeds the audit-log summary and the issues-used meter. With the corrected count (9 in the reported case), the meter now goes down by the right amount, so it matches a recount of live issues. Issues already archived keep their original archive date. The update is still limited to the one project in the one workspace, so other projects aren't touched.

The fix doesn't repair the affected workspace's data. Its meter will be off until the periodic usage rollup recounts it. The 3 older issues still carry this week's archive date, so someone needs to restore their original dates by hand for the retention sweep to be correct.
